task.title: P6-081: [parked] Run the deferred cross-browser compatibility pass
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-081. Size: M, decision. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Cross-browser compatibility pass, deferred wholesale 2026-07-25** — the loop runs chromium only, so firefox and webkit breakage accumulates unseen. `end2end/playwright.config.ts` still defines both projects (and its own comment, "full three-browser tier… revised 2026-07-20", now contradicts the skill's chromium-only practice — fix that line whenever this is touched), so the debt is one `npx playwright test` away from being measured. Note the original webkit rationale (it proxies WKWebView, so a webkit-broken overlay breaks the macOS shell) now rides on the desktop smoke instead.

**Trigger: a pre-release claim about desktop/WKWebView, or a decided fixed cadence.**
